L1.title: GW170817 confines the vestigial-second-sound graviton identification to one part in 10^15 of its natural range
L1.topic: Conditional c_GW=c sqrt(chi_vest) constraint from conservative GW170817 cap; exact nonnegative compatible interval and adopted-range width comparison; conditional scalar gamma*omega dispersion; internal Planck-anchor Newton-constant comparison. Physical susceptibility normalization, microscopic modes and transport matching remain open.
key_claims: Assume c_GW=c sqrt(chi_vest), with nonnegative chi_vest and positive c; the physical spin-2 identification is not derived by this law.

At fixed conservative tau=3e-15, |sqrt(chi_vest)-1|<=tau iff chi_vest lies in [(1-tau)^2,(1+tau)^2]; exact width 4tau=1.2e-14. Returned floating endpoints and their subtraction are approximations, not an exact-width certificate.

The compatible interval contains chi_vest=1 and lies strictly inside the project-adopted [0.1,10]; natural width 9.9 divided by 4tau equals 8.25e14. This is a width ratio; probability requires an explicit prior.

At adopted endpoints 0.1 and 10 the deviations are approximately -0.6838 and 2.1623, exceeding tau by approximately 2.28e14 and 7.21e14. These endpoint failures do not exclude the interior compatible interval.

The tracked scalar positivity/compatibility/sub-half-deviation predicate holds throughout the compatible interval and at chi_vest=1; its pointwise falsifiers do not derive a microscopic mode or formalize the missing-dynamics H1 caveat.

For the defined scalar correction gamma*omega with omega>0, tolerance is equivalent to |gamma|<=tol/omega. The 1e-30 scaffold at literal 100 is conditional arithmetic; physical Gamma_H units, angular-frequency convention and retarded transport matching remain open.

In the internal Sakharov-Adler parameterization G_N_emerg=alpha_ADW*12pi/(N_f*Lambda_UV^2), the adopted Planck anchor reduces the matching coefficient to N_f/(12pi). Project counts {15,16,45,48} yield rounded 0.40 through 1.27 inside adopted [0.1,10]; this is input-dependent comparison, not a derived physical ADW coefficient.
